rows.description: They discuss what commitment means: where to live, family, children, careers and each other's parents. Concrete talk replaces vague reassurance, and disagreement found now is cheaper than after a wedding.

rows.subtype: Stage 6: Choosing each other, with eyes open [Response]
rows.description: The couple commits knowing the other's flaws and trusting their way of resolving trouble. A steady bond built on respect tends to hold better than one built on intensity.
graph_context: previous stage: The honest conversation

rows.subtopic: A relationship's slow drift and breakup
rows.description: In a first relationship, two teenagers talk for hours and feel that the other is the centre of the world. Everything else, including friends and studies, is at risk of fading into the background.
graph_context: next stage: Small cracks
this subtopic also appears at ages: 23–26

rows.subtopic: A relationship's slow drift and breakup
rows.description: Replies become slower, one is annoyed by the other's need for constant contact, and the other by a growing distance. Neither says so, because saying it might make it real.
graph_context: previous stage: Fresh and consuming
next stage: Avoidance and mixed signals
this subtopic also appears at ages: 23–26
related mind states: anger

rows.subtopic: A relationship's slow drift and breakup
rows.description: One starts to feel bored or trapped and hints instead of saying it. The other senses a change, becomes clingier, and each new sign of need pushes the first further away.
graph_context: previous stage: Small cracks
next stage: The decision
this subtopic also appears at ages: 23–26
related mind states: boredom

rows.subtopic: A relationship's slow drift and breakup
rows.description: One privately decides it is over but delays, afraid of hurting the other and of the fuss among friends. Delay feels kind, but often adds pain, since the other keeps hoping.
graph_context: previous stage: Avoidance and mixed signals
next stage: A clear, kind ending
this subtopic also appears at ages: 23–26
related mind states: fear, hurt

rows.subtopic: A relationship's slow drift and breakup
rows.description: The one ending says it face to face or by call, briefly and without insults or false hope: "I do not feel the same, and I do not want to mislead you". Clarity is a form of respect.
graph_context: previous stage: The decision
next stage: Grief and the after
this subtopic also appears at ages: 23–26
related mind states: admiration, hope

rows.subtopic: A relationship's slow drift and breakup
rows.description: The one left feels rejection, a hollow chest and the urge to check social media all day. Lean on friends and family, avoid retaliatory posts, and remember that pain of this size is real and does ease.
graph_context: previous stage: A clear, kind ending
this subtopic also appears at ages: 23–26
related mind states: grief, hurt

rows.subtopic: A relationship's slow drift and breakup
rows.description: A couple together for several years live in easy routine. Comfort is real, and it also lets each stop asking about the other's inner life, so small changes go unspoken.
graph_context: next stage: Diverging paths
this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17

rows.subtopic: A relationship's slow drift and breakup
rows.description: One is pulled toward a career move or a different way of life while the other wants stability near family. The talks about the future become polite and short, with big questions left for later.
graph_context: previous stage: Comfortable years
next stage: Emotional distance
